description: This file defines React components for a toggle group UI element, leveraging radix-ui primitives and custom styling utilities. It includes context for managing variants and sizes, and exports ToggleGroup and ToggleGroupItem components.

methods.name: ToggleGroup
methods.description: A React component that renders a toggle group container, manages context for variants and sizes, and passes props to radix-ui's Root component.

methods.name: ToggleGroupItem
methods.description: A React component that represents a toggle item within the toggle group, consuming context and applying styling based on variant and size.
